name: Ticket Expiration
author: Alexis
description: Adds a clock to the OrgCS header that counts the open cases you own whose next follow-up is due, following the team's cadence: Working every 2 days, Need More Information every 3 days with a closure warning after 7 days without a reply, open Structured Investigations every 3 days, high priority daily. Click it for each case's next step and due date; case lists show the due time next to each case number, and your case pages next to Follow.

settings.title: High priority (daily follow-up)
settings.description: Which severities get a follow-up every day. Escalated cases always do.

settings.title: Need More Information: follow up every (days)
Need More Information: closure warning after (days without a reply)
settings.description: The warning tells the customer the case closes in 48 hours without a reply; 48 hours later the case is due to be closed.

settings.title: Open Structured Investigation: a note every (days)
Any other status: activity at least every (days)
Skip weekends
settings.description: Off: days are calendar days, so a case updated on Friday with a 2-day cadence is due on Sunday. On: due dates skip Saturday and Sunday.

settings.title: Notify me when a case becomes overdue
Show due times in case lists
settings.description: A pill next to each of your case numbers in My Open Cases and other case lists. Hover it for the next step.

settings.title: Show the follow-up on your case pages
settings.description: A pill in front of Follow on cases you own, with the due time; hover it for the next step, click it for the panel.
